rationale: Price is at 99.5% of today's range and within $0.03 of the session high, meaning the risk/reward for a long is extremely compressed with almost no room before hitting resistance at the high. A short against a strong uptrend (price well above VWAP at $98.87, above 9-EMA at $100.64, and up ~4.6% from prior close) carries significant momentum risk. With the broad market slightly negative and VIXY slightly elevated, the setup lacks a clean directional edge with acceptable stop placement.
